title: Sandbox detection (sleep/CPU checks)
hypothesis: Malware slept or performed CPU/RAM checks to evade sandboxing.
queries: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName has_any ('powershell.exe','cmd.exe') | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'Start-Sleep' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'ping -n ' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'timeout'
rationale: Long sleeps before behavior = sandbox evasion.
